items.title: Copyright Alliance Calls Meta's Proposed Business Terms 'Unconscionable'
items.summary: Copyright Alliance members including RIAA, NMPA and UMG call Meta's new commercial-account terms unconscionable, prompting Meta to weigh delaying the rollout.

items.title: Suno Pushes to Make Apple Testify on Apple Music's Reliance on Major Labels
items.summary: Suno wants an Apple witness to testify on whether Apple Music could survive without UMG and Sony, alleging majors leverage catalogs against AI rivals.

items.title: Garth Brooks Cancels Kansas City Show After Bots Flood Ticket Queue
items.summary: Garth Brooks canceled a Kansas City matinee after bots made up most of a 90,000-plus ticket queue, with fans automatically refunded.

items.title: Suno Launches MCP Tool for Making Songs Inside ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini
items.summary: Suno unveiled a beta MCP tool letting users generate songs from within AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, alongside a new developer API portal.

items.title: Spotify Plans Q1 2027 Launch for AI Covers and Remixes Tool
items.summary: Spotify is reportedly targeting a Q1 2027 launch for an AI-powered covers and remixes tool, weighing a $4-$5 monthly add-on price.

items.title: Universal Music Group Posts $3.90B Q3 Revenue, Up 11.7% Year-Over-Year
items.summary: Universal Music Group generated $3.90 billion in Q3 revenue, up 11.7% year-over-year, driven by releases from Olivia Rodrigo, Stray Kids and Ariana Grande.

items.title: Hayley Silvertown Named Chief Legal and Business Affairs Officer at Create Music Group
items.summary: Create Music Group named Hayley Silvertown Chief Legal and Business Affairs Officer, overseeing legal functions and strategic transactions for the company.

items.title: Audio Chateau Records Secures Up to $9M in Series A Funding
items.summary: Jared Gutstadt's Audio Chateau Records secured up to $9 million in Series A funding, with producer Poo Bear joining as a strategic advisor.

items.title: YouTube Music and Premium Surpass 150 Million Subscribers Globally
items.summary: YouTube Music and Premium have surpassed 150 million subscribers worldwide, a milestone disclosed by Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai.

items.title: My Chemical Romance Release Animated Short Film With Phoebe Bridgers, Billie Eilish
items.summary: My Chemical Romance released the animated short 'Prelude to the End' with visual artist Lauren Tsai, featuring voice work from Phoebe Bridgers and Billie Eilish.

items.title: Maryland Is Getting Its Own (Mini) Sphere
items.summary: Prince George's County, Maryland approved up to $215 million for a smaller Sphere-style venue at National Harbor.

items.title: Moog Launches Model 112 and Model 210 Amplifiers
items.summary: Moog launched two new amplifiers, the compact Model 112 at $799 and the higher-powered Model 210 at $999, aimed at letting instruments' character shine through.

items.title: L-Acoustics' SoundVision Connect Could Be a Collaboration Powerhouse for Concert Design
items.summary: L-Acoustics launched SoundVision Connect with a new Plus tier offering cloud project storage and collaboration tools for concert sound designers.

items.title: ADAM Audio's H715 Headphones Feature Sonnox Calibration Suite
items.summary: ADAM Audio launched its H715 flagship reference headphones with custom drivers, a Sonnox Calibration Suite, and a dedicated Hi-Fi listening mode.

items.title: This New Plugin Lets You Mix Your Music in 3D
items.summary: Art DSP released Canvas 2.0, a plugin that represents tracks as movable 3D objects with built-in EQ, spectral sidechaining and reverb.

items.title: Massive XL: Native Instruments' Next-Gen Flagship Soft Synth Has Arrived
items.summary: Native Instruments launched Massive XL, its first major plugin since the InMusic acquisition, adding new sound design tools and 100+ wavetables.

items.title: FL Studio Mobile 5 Update Brings Library of Two Million Samples
items.summary: FL Studio Mobile 5 adds access to the FL Cloud Sounds library of over two million samples, plus a new portrait edit mode.

items.title: Sinevibes Malfunction v3 Adds Modulated Mayhem to Circuit-Bent Filter Plugin
items.summary: Sinevibes released version 3 of its circuit-bent Malfunction filter plugin, adding precise modulation across a wider variety of shapes.

items.title: XEN FX LAB: Sequel to Zen Delay Adds Tweakable Spring Tank, Dub Mode
items.summary: A follow-up to Zen Delay, XEN FX LAB adds a modeled spring reverb, a tank-strike function and a dub-throw mode across desktop and iOS.

items.title: HAND Is a Eurorack Module That Is Also a Disembodied Crawling Hand
items.summary: Instrument builder Gijs Gieskes released HAND, a novelty Eurorack module shaped like a crawling, glowing disembodied hand.

items.title: Inside NI Absynth 6.2 and Its Updated Workflows for Exploring Sound
items.summary: Native Instruments updated Absynth to version 6.2, refining its UI and editing navigation to streamline sound-shaping workflows.

items.title: Roland TR-1000 1.5 Update Adds Keyboard Mode, Seamless Kit Switching
items.summary: Roland's TR-1000 1.5 firmware update adds note sequencing, a requested keyboard mode, and seamless pattern and kit switching with effects running.

items.title: Wētā FX Showcases 'Moana' Work
items.summary: Wētā FX shared a behind-the-scenes showcase of its visual effects work on Moana.

items.title: New Foundry Video Looks at Use of Katana, Nuke and USD by Pixar in 'Toy Story 5'
items.summary: A new Foundry video, featuring VFX supervisor Thomas Jordan, details Pixar's pipeline use of Katana, Nuke and USD on Toy Story 5.

items.title: Watch Image Engine's VFX Breakdown for 'The Mandalorian & Grogu'
items.summary: Image Engine released a behind-the-scenes VFX breakdown reel for Star Wars feature The Mandalorian & Grogu.

items.title: Watch Framestore's VFX Breakdown for 'East of Eden'
items.summary: Framestore published a visual effects breakdown reel showing its work on the film East of Eden.

items.title: Digital Domain's VFX Breakdown for 'Disclosure Day' Is Here
items.summary: Digital Domain released a breakdown of its 418 VFX shots for Spielberg's Disclosure Day, covering a train chase, aliens and more.

items.title: Project Hail Mary: FPS Giving Greig Fraser the Controls
items.summary: Framestore Pre-production Services detail putting virtual cameras, lighting and live composites directly in cinematographer Greig Fraser's hands for Project Hail Mary.

items.title: DNEG on Making Cartoon Logic Work in 'Coyote vs. Acme'
items.summary: DNEG's VFX supervisor and animation director discuss grounding cartoon physics for the live-action/animation hybrid Coyote vs. Acme.

items.title: 'Dune: Part Three' Unleashes Its Third and Final Trailer
items.summary: Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three dropped its final trailer, with Paul Lambert returning as VFX supervisor and DNEG leading effects; it opens December 18.

items.title: Framestore Revisits the CG Joey and 300-Strong Cavalry of 'War Horse'
items.summary: For War Horse's anniversary, Framestore recounts building a digital Joey and a 300-strong cavalry extended from 60 real riders.

items.title: Accenture Song Builds the Green Lantern Constructs for 'Lanterns'
items.summary: Accenture Song's VFX team shaped Green Lantern energy constructs, from a detailed dollar bill to a glowing tunnel, for DC's HBO Max series Lanterns.

items.title: Microdrama Platform FlareFlow Sets Thailand Launch on AIS Play
items.summary: Vertical-video platform FlareFlow will launch in Thailand through telecom AIS's Play service on Nov. 2, priced at about $1.15 a month.

items.title: Rishab Shetty's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Epic 'The Pride of Bharat' Lands T-Series
items.summary: India's T-Series boarded Sandeep Singh's historical epic starring Rishab Shetty as the Maratha king, now split into two parts filming from early 2027.

items.title: AI Dubbing Pioneer Flawless Sells Technology in Deal That Raises Questions About Its Future
items.summary: Flawless, which spent $100 million on SAG-AFTRA-endorsed AI dubbing tech used on films like Fall, sold its TrueSync and DeepEditor IP to startup TBellScout.

items.title: Skydance International Sets Its Four Regional Leads; Andrew Georgiou Exiting Europe & Africa Role
items.summary: Following its $110B merger, Skydance named four regional international leads as JB Perrette finalized its structure, with Andrew Georgiou departing the Europe & Africa post.

items.title: Japan's Animation Industry Grows 15.8% to Record $28BN, Driven by Domestic and Overseas Sales
items.summary: Japan's anime industry grew 15.8% to $28.18 billion in 2025, with overseas sales now making up nearly 57% of the total, per AJA figures at TIFFCOM.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA Members Ratify TV Animation Contracts, Securing 12.6% Wage Increase for Voice Actors
items.summary: SAG-AFTRA members ratified new four-year TV and basic cable animation agreements with a 12.6% wage increase and enhanced AI protections.

items.title: Matthew Weiner Exits Eddie Murphy Peacock Series 'The Chairman' as Showrunner
items.summary: Mad Men creator Matthew Weiner has departed as showrunner of Peacock's Eddie Murphy drama The Chairman, from 101 Studios and Universal Television.

items.title: Bleecker Street CEO on Why the Social Media Suppression of 'Musk' Is About Much More Than Film
items.summary: Bleecker Street's CEO discusses how social platforms suppressed ads for its Elon Musk documentary, which still saw a PVOD pre-sales surge despite box-office struggles.

items.title: Japan's TeamLab Bringing Permanent Digital Art Exhibition Space to California
items.summary: Digital art collective TeamLab will open its first permanent U.S. exhibition space, TeamLab Anaheim, set to debut in 2030.

items.summary: A video examined whether generative AI is beginning to replace traditional VFX workflows, drawing over 1.3 million views.

items.title: Corridor Crew releases open-source green screen tool

items.title: Ghost Stride animated short film

items.summary: A vocal analysis video examined the technique behind K-pop star Lisa's singing, drawing over 1.2 million views.

items.summary: A hands-on review covered Arturia's newly released MiniFreak 49 keyboard synthesizer, four years after the original MiniFreak.

items.summary: TapNow detailed its AI filmmaking process for the series Primordia using its Creative OS tool, in a breakdown drawing over 643,000 views.
